name: The Imperial Guards of Ming Dynasty
description: The Gongwei Department formerly established by Ming Taizu Zhu Yuanzhang was later renamed the "Qinjun Duwei Mansion" and was directly responsible to the emperor. In the fifteenth year of Hongwu's reign, Jinyiwei was restructured. The main functions of Jinyiwei are to serve as bodyguards and to inspect and arrest criminals and prisons. Whenever the emperor held a court meeting or when the priests went out on parade, the royal guards were always by their side to protect the emperor's safety. He is wearing a flying fish suit, a turban, a hat, and an embroidered spring knife. He is tall and tall, and his overall image is majestic and slightly mysterious. He has a strong body and quick actions, and can complete every task promptly and quickly.
